name: Babel_SingleOrigin_Serial
source: A single-recent-origin (Babel-style) counterpart to the out-of-Africa OutOfAfrica_3G09 scenario, authored as a sibling demography.json to run in the SAME engine under the SAME fixed seed. One origin deme disperses SEQUENTIALLY into a chain of daughter demes (0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4); each dispersal founds the next deme from a small, DECAYING sample of the previous one (2500 -> 1500 -> 900 -> 500 diploids), producing a serial founder effect. Deme N therefore sits N founder steps from the origin (its serial-split rank), exactly the axis the heterozygosity-vs-distance analysis fits. The scientific question (roadmap 6c, second bullet): does a single-origin serial dispersal reproduce the near-linear heterozygosity decline (Ramachandran 2005 / Prugnolle 2005) claimed as an out-of-Africa signature? Sizes are diploid Ne, times in generations, migration per-generation per-lineage (nearest-neighbour stepping-stone only, to preserve the linear structure). generation_time and rescale Q match the OoA file for a like-for-like comparison.
